point: A which-question with a condition: rule out the contradicted answer.
帶條件的 which 問句：刪掉與條件矛盾的回答。
why: The question says the morning departure has been canceled. The one that leaves right after lunch names a different flight, so it fits.
問句說 the morning departure has been canceled。回答 The one that leaves right after lunch 指的是另一班飛機，所以符合。

gloss.ex: Our departure is scheduled for noon.
They canceled the meeting yesterday.
I always book an aisle seat.

point: How many: the answer can be that the number is not final yet.
How many：回答可以是人數還沒確定。
why: The guest list doubled from a hundred, so the final number is still open. The final replies aren't due until Friday says the count is not fixed.
賓客名單已從一百人加倍，最後人數還沒定。回答 The final replies aren't due until Friday 表示人數還沒確定。

gloss.ex: We set up the room early.
She checked the guest list twice.
Please send your reply by Friday.

point: A yes/no question answered indirectly: the parts have not left yet.
Yes/No 問句的間接回答：零件還沒出貨。
why: The parts must arrive before the inspectors come on Friday. The supplier hasn't even shipped them yet means they will not make it, so the answer is no.
零件要在檢查員星期五來之前到。回答 The supplier hasn't even shipped them yet 表示來不及，所以答案是不會。

gloss.ex: We ordered a replacement part today.
The inspector visits every spring.
The order shipped on Monday.

point: A direct answer: Yes, plus an action.
直接回答：Yes，再加一個動作。
why: She asks whether he has the schedule. Yes, I'll e-mail it to you right now answers her and offers the file. The other replies talk about numbers and places.
她問他有沒有時程表。回答 Yes, I'll e-mail it to you right now 回答了問題，還提供檔案。其他回答講的是人數和地點。

gloss.ex: We have five candidates for the job.
The interviews start at nine.
We have sold ten tickets so far.

point: A yes/no question can get the answer: it depends.
Yes/No 問句可以回答：看情況。
why: He asks about an extra charge for a different location. That depends on which branch you choose means the charge changes by branch, so it is neither yes nor no.
他問換地點還車有沒有額外費用。回答 That depends on which branch you choose 表示費用要看分店，所以不是單純的 Yes 或 No。

gloss.ex: There is no extra charge for delivery.
It depends on the weather.
The downtown branch opens at nine.

point: Main topic: join the problem and the fix.
主旨：把問題和對策串起來。
why: The woman gives the problem first, patients who didn't show up. Then comes the fix: A text message would reach more of them. Together they are about getting people to keep their visits.
女方先說問題：病患 didn't show up。接著是對策：A text message would reach more of them。合起來是要讓更多人準時來看診。

point: Why mention something: look for the point behind it.
為什麼提到某事：找它背後的意思。
why: He asks What would it cost, though? and adds that the owner already turned down a new reception desk. He is hinting that the owner does not like to spend money.
他問 What would it cost, though?，再說老闆 already turned down a new reception desk。他在暗示老闆不愛花錢。

point: Match the action to the right day and person.
把動作對到正確的日子和人。
why: Let's start the trial on Monday is the trial. I'll bring it up with the owner at Thursday's meeting is his task at the meeting: he will present the idea to the owner.
Let's start the trial on Monday 是試用。I'll bring it up with the owner at Thursday's meeting 才是他在星期四要做的事：向老闆提出這個想法。

gloss.ex: Each no-show wastes an hour.
She turned down the job offer.
That will free up some time.
We started a trial last week.
Please check in at the reception desk.

point: The words after worried point to the problem.
worried 後面的字就是問題所在。
why: Rosa says I'm worried about the demo video. Tom then says the client's projector only accepts an older file type, so the video may not play.
Rosa 說 I'm worried about the demo video。Tom 接著說客戶的投影機 only accepts an older file type，所以影片可能播不出來。

point: An idiom: it means the projector is very old.
慣用說法：意思是投影機很老舊。
why: Tom says the projector only accepts an older file type. Gareth adds It belongs in a museum. He means it is badly out of date, not that it should go to a museum.
Tom 說投影機 only accepts an older file type。Gareth 接著說 It belongs in a museum，意思是它太過時，不是真的要放進博物館。

point: Follow the change: proposal, objection, agreement.
跟著變化走：提議、反對、同意。
why: Rosa asks for eight. Gareth says the building opens at eight thirty and suggests eight forty-five. Rosa agrees with That works, so it is a quarter to nine.
Rosa 提議 eight。Gareth 說大樓 eight thirty 才開，改提 eight forty-five。Rosa 回 That works，所以是八點四十五分。

gloss.ex: The meeting is in the boardroom.
This printer accepts every file type.
Please convert the file to PDF.
That old phone belongs in a museum.
Wait for me in the lobby.

point: Purpose: the reason and the offer, taken together.
目的：把原因和提議合起來看。
why: She says The Garden Room is no longer available, then I can offer you the Skyline Room instead. The call is to suggest another venue for his dinner.
她說 The Garden Room is no longer available，接著說 I can offer you the Skyline Room instead。來電是為了替他的晚宴建議另一個場地。

point: A drawback: listen for what follows but.
缺點題：聽 but 後面接什麼。
why: She says the room is bigger, but it has no built-in microphone system. That means it does not come with sound equipment.
她說房間比較大，but it has no built-in microphone system。意思是它沒有附音響設備。

point: Sequence: before and once show what comes first.
順序：before 和 once 顯示誰先誰後。
why: Before you order anything, please look over the floor plan comes first. The call is for once you've seen the plan, so it comes after. Reviewing the layout is the first step.
Before you order anything, please look over the floor plan 排在第一。打電話是 once you've seen the plan，在之後。所以先看房間配置。

gloss.ex: That model is no longer available.
A pipe burst in the basement.
The phone has a built-in camera.
Please check the floor plan first.
Can you hold a table for us?
